answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent posts a 50 POA bond to enter a harbor. It must finish 10 tasks over 5 epochs; timing, task mix and counterparties form a fingerprint, checked against a reef of sybil patterns. Passers unlock the bond; clones sharing a fingerprint lose it and sit on an island ledger. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA for a 3,000 POA pool, so farming loses money. Honest agents pay once and are never diluted.
